name: SafeStage
summary: Evaluates closed-loop manipulation safety by stage: Hazards to be resolved before acting, unsafe contacts and region entries during execution, and unstable states after completion. Implemented in Isaac Sim within NVIDIA's RoboLab.
numbers: 97 risk scenarios; π0.5, GR00T N1.7, DreamZero, Cosmos3 Nano Policy on a simulated DROID Franka

why.cx: Tabletop tasks with pre- and post-conditions.
why.cog: Implicit hazards in the initial and final state.
